_comment: Allow-list of apps the UI testing adapter may drive. Copy to
authorized_targets.json and edit. Nothing is in scope unless it is listed here.
environment must be one of: test, demo, staging, sandbox, local. A production
bundle id cannot be declared -- AuthorizedTarget rejects it.
authorization_ref is the ticket, contract or written permission that covers this
testing, and owner is the person accountable for the test account/data. Both are
mandatory so a run can always be traced back to who authorized it.
allow_business_writes defaults to false. Turn it on only for a target where
completing a real business operation (a transfer, an order, a reward claim) is
part of the agreed test scope, on test data. It stays false for anything backed
by real money, a real campaign or a real third-party account.

targets.notes: Demo build used by the adapter's own integration tests.
